focus: 今天的重點：看時鐘說幾點四十五分、聽顏色、Can you…?、What color…?、讀菜單找價錢和時間、現在進行式 is + -ing、用 but 連接。
notes: 聽力第 1 題：8:45 唸成 eight forty-five，要分清楚 forty-five（45）和 fifteen（15）。可以用家裡的時鐘輪流考。
閱讀段落填空第 1 格：Kane and I 是兩個人，動詞用原形 play，不加 s；第 3 題練 an egg（母音開頭用 an）。
寫作第 1 題第一次練「現在正在做」：is + 動詞-ing（reads → is reading）；第 2 題意思相反用 but。

listen.q: What time does the clock show?
listen.why: 短針靠近 9、長針指 9，是 8:45：eight forty-five。eight fifteen 是 8:15。
圖上的包包是紫色：purple。pink 是粉紅色。
Can you…? 問「你會不會」，用 Yes, I can. 或 No, I can't. 回答。

talk: What color are your shoes, Kyro?
listen.why: What color 問「什麼顏色」，要回答顏色：They are white（白色的）。

talk: Kyro, it's cold and rainy today.
Can I wear my yellow raincoat, Dad?
Yes. And take your umbrella, too.
listen.q: What is the weather like this morning?
listen.why: 爸爸說 it's cold and rainy today：今天又冷又下雨。

talk: Yes! I play basketball with Kane every Sunday.
listen.q: Who does Kyro play basketball with?
listen.why: Kyro 說 I play basketball with Kane：他和哥哥 Kane 一起打籃球。

talk: Hello, everyone. Tomorrow is our park day. Please bring a hat. It will be hot and sunny. We will meet at the school gate at nine.
listen.q: What should the children bring tomorrow?
listen.why: 公告說 Please bring a hat：請帶帽子，因為明天會很熱、出太陽。

talk: This is my favorite toy. It is small and blue. It has four wheels. I can push it on the floor. It goes very fast. Kane has one, too.
listen.why: 有四個輪子（four wheels）、可以推著跑很快，是藍色的玩具車。

vocab.stem: I brush my ____ every morning and night.
vocab.why: 每天早晚刷的是牙齒：teeth（tooth 的複數）。

vocab.stem: A ____ helps sick people in the hospital.
vocab.why: 在醫院（hospital）照顧生病的人的是護理師：nurse，是學校 LA 的單字。
egg 的第一個字母 e 是母音，要用 an：an egg。two 和 many 後面要接 eggs。

cloze.passage: Dear Amy, Hello from Kenting! The sea is blue and the sun is hot. Kane and I {1} on the beach every day. We find many small shells. There is a big crab {2} a rock. It is red. See you next week! Kyro

items.why: Kane and I 是兩個人，動詞用原形 play，不加 s。
螃蟹在石頭的下面：under a rock。

text.intro: 讀下面麵店的菜單，回答三個問題。
text.title: Happy Noodle House

items.stem: How much is the corn soup?
items.why: 菜單上 Corn soup（玉米濃湯）是 $40。

items.stem: What drink can you buy here?
items.why: 菜單上唯一的飲料是 Black tea（紅茶）。

items.stem: What time does the shop open?
items.why: 菜單寫 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.：早上 11 點開門，晚上 8 點關門。

write.instr: 改成「現在正在做」的句子（is + 動詞-ing）。
near: is 後面的動詞要改成 -ing：reading。
reading 前面要加 is：Kane is reading…
要改成正在做：Kane is reading a book.
hints: reads 去掉 s，加上 ing，前面放 is。

write.instr: 用 but 把兩句合成一句。
accept: kyro can swim but kane can't swim
kyro can swim but kane cannot swim
kyro can swim but kane can not swim
write.model: Kyro can swim, but Kane can't swim.
near: 一個會、一個不會，意思相反，用 but，不是 and。
意思相反用 but，不是 or。
but 後面要說是誰不會：Kane can't swim。
hints: 兩句意思相反，中間用 but，前面加逗號。
Kyro can swim, ___ Kane can't swim.

write.instr: 依照順序點字卡，排成一句話。
hints: 大寫字母開頭的字放第一個，有句點的字放最後。
第一張是紫色的花：purple；時鐘是三點：three。
小鳥在樹上（樹葉裡）：in the tree。
